name: Raspberry Pi Compute Module 5 IO Board · rev 2
description: Bare CM5 carrier board. 160 × 90 mm PCB; compute module, case and accessories excluded.

catalog.sourceName: Raspberry Pi product and mechanical design files

attributeConditions.hdmi: Physically fitted HDMI sockets; additional FFC video connections are not counted.

geometryEvidence.summary: PCB outline, mounting holes and major connector envelopes reconstructed from the cited manufacturer design revision. CM5 is not fitted.
geometryEvidence.limitations: Authored reconstruction from official revision 2 KiCad geometry and connector reference models. Five components have source footprint XY dimensions and approximate heights. Nominal PCB thickness is 1.6 mm from the general KiCad field; the exported source stackup is 1.51 mm. Connector bodies are seated on the nominal PCB faces. Solder tails, traces and small electronics are omitted. B2B open-shell reference envelopes are reconstructed as closed bodies; cavity profiles, individual GPIO contacts and colors are illustrative. The source archive notes that some component models are approximate.

geometryEvidence.summary: PCB outline, mounting holes and major connector envelopes reconstructed from the cited manufacturer design revision. CM5 is not fitted.
geometryEvidence.limitations: Authored reconstruction from the manufacturer STEP dated 2025-02-25. PCB corner radius 3.5 mm is inferred from CAD tangent geometry, not a dimensioned callout. Major connector envelopes and mounting bores are source measured. Solder tails, traces and small electronics are omitted; cavities, individual GPIO contacts and colors are illustrative. The source inserted microSD card is excluded. The CR1220 holder and several FFC connectors extend below the PCB.
